title: workqueueitem
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser, processinguser, workqueueid.

completedon.description: The date and time when the work queue item was completed.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

delayuntil.description: The date and time after which the work queue item can be dequeued again.

executioncontext.description: The execution context contains a system-managed list of processing attempts, along with important debugging information.

expirydate.description: The expiry date indicates the deadline when the work queue items has to be processed by.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

input.description: The input field contains the actual work item data used for processing by bots, humans, or integrations.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

latestflowrunid.description: Unique identifier of the flow run that processed the item.

machineuser.description: Machine User that processed the item.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

name.description: The name of the work queue item which is by default set to an auto number (e.g., 2023-02-13-000000001).

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

priority.description: The priority value determines the pick and processing order for work queue items in a work queue.

processingduration.description: The duration of the processing in seconds.

processingstarttime.description: The date and time when the processing has started.

processorid.description: Unique identifier for the processor (workflow, flowmachine, etc.) that processed the item.

processortype.description: The processor type allows to display if the item was processed through a cloud flow, a flow machine or another processor type.

requeuecount.description: The number of times the item has been requeued.

retrycount.description: The number of times the item has been retried.

slastatus.description: The SLA status provides more context for on the item processing status (In SLA, At Risk, Out of SLA).

slathresholddate.description: Date and time on which the work queue item starts to be at risk of SLA violation.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statecode.description: The status of the work queue item (Queued, Processed, Exception etc.)

statuscode.description: The status reason provides more context for a set status (Queued, Processing, On hold etc.).

uniqueidbyqueue.description: An identifier of the work queue item used to uniquely identify a work queue item inside a work queue.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.

_processinguser_value.description: Unique identifier for the user that processed the item.

_workqueueid_value.description: The work queue id of the parent work queue record.
